svg.title: Figure 10 · American put exercise boundary estimated by a CRR lattice
svg.desc: S₀ = K = 100, r = 5%, q = 0, σ = 20%, T = 1. This is the highest exercise node at each time level of a 1,600-step CRR lattice, not a smoothed exact boundary. The last pre-expiry nodes approach K; the sawtooth pattern reflects the lattice.
